statement:
∀ (t : ℝ) (f : KdVPlan.Coeff), KdVPlan.ZeroMean f → KdVPlan.RealField f →
  KdVPlan.ZeroMean (KdVPlan.S t f) ∧ KdVPlan.RealField (KdVPlan.S t f)
proof:
intro t f hz hr
constructor
· change Complex.exp _ * f 0 = 0
  rw [hz, mul_zero]
· intro k
  change Complex.exp _ * f (-k) = star (Complex.exp _ * f k)
  rw [hr k]
  simp only [star_mul', Complex.star_def]
  congr 1
  rw [← Complex.exp_conj]
  congr 1
  simp
  <;> ring
